claim: With continuous ECR scanning, Amazon Inspector by default monitors images pushed within the last 14 days or last used within 14 days, or scanned within the configured re-scan duration; accounts created before May 16, 2024 default to images pushed or pulled within the last 90 days.
question: By default, for how long does Amazon Inspector keep rescanning an ECR image?

qualifiers.scope: per ECR image with continuous scanning
qualifiers.condition: accounts created before May 16, 2024 default to 90 days

q: docs/inspector/latest/user/scanning-ecr

If continuous scanning is enabled, Amazon Inspector monitors images as long as they were pushed within 14 days (by default), the last-in-use date is within 14 days (by default), or the images are scanned within the configured re-scan duration. For Amazon Inspector accounts that were created prior to May 16, 2024, the default configuration is for re-scan to monitor images if they were pushed or pulled within the last 90 days.
note: d048. Options include 3-day and 7-day settings since 2026-07-09 (history row).

claim: When ECR scanning is first activated, Amazon Inspector detects and scans images pushed within the last 14 days, and it scans only images whose ECR status is ACTIVE, not ARCHIVED.
question: Which existing ECR images does Amazon Inspector scan when ECR scanning is first turned on?
q: docs/inspector/latest/user/scanning-ecr
When you first activate Amazon ECR scanning, Amazon Inspector detects images pushed within the last 14 days.

claim: When an active ECR image becomes archived, Amazon Inspector closes its findings automatically and deletes them after 3 days.
question: What happens to Amazon Inspector findings for an ECR image that is archived?
q: docs/inspector/latest/user/scanning-ecr
When an active image in ECR is transitioned to archived, Amazon Inspector automatically closes findings and then deletes the findings after 3 days.

claim: After the initial scan, Amazon Inspector evaluates SSM inventory for an EC2 instance every 30 minutes by default, and rescans an instance when a new CVE that affects it is added to its database.
question: How often does Amazon Inspector re-evaluate an agent-based EC2 instance?
q: docs/inspector/latest/user/scanning-ec2

After this, the **Last scanned** field is updated when Amazon Inspector evaluates SSM inventory (every 30 minutes by default), or when an instance is re-scanned because a new CVE impacting that instance was added to the Amazon Inspector database.
note: Continuous scanning: new CVEs trigger rescans.

claim: With hybrid scanning, Amazon Inspector runs agentless scans on eligible EC2 instances every 24 hours and detects and scans newly eligible instances, such as instances without SSM agents, every hour.
question: How often does Amazon Inspector run agentless EC2 scans in hybrid mode?

qualifiers.scope: per account configured for hybrid scanning

q: docs/inspector/latest/user/scanning-ec2

When your account is configured for **Hybrid scanning**, Amazon Inspector performs agentless scans on eligible instances every 24 hours. Amazon Inspector detects and scans newly eligible instances every hour, which includes new instances without SSM agents, or pre-existing instances with statuses that have changed to `SSM_UNMANAGED`.
